item.content:encoded:
Mix3Design is a web design agency. We’re inviting freelancers from anywhere in the world to join us in designing and maintaining client websites built with WordPress.

What you’ll do

  • Design and build WordPress websites
  • Maintain and update existing client sites
  • Collaborate with our team to deliver projects on time

What we offer

  • 100% remote work
  • Payment per project
  • Ongoing work for people who deliver great results
